fields.description: Marina Place 1 brings apartments and a small group of two-level townhouses to Rashid Yachts & Marina. It forms one part of the two-tower Marina Place development, connected by a landscaped podium. Apartments suit different household sizes, while the townhouses separate their ground-floor living spaces from bedrooms on the podium level.

overview: The brochure describes restrained architecture with natural materials, generous glazing and outdoor spaces. The podium combines gardens and shared recreation, while the surrounding promenade adds places to walk, dine and meet. A marina or skyline outlook depends on the chosen unit and cannot be promised across the collection.
research.locationNote: Marina Place 1 is in Mina Rashid, within Emaar’s Rashid Yachts & Marina community. The developer identifies the QE2 Hotel, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport as nearby destinations. Community attractions and project facilities have separate delivery and access arrangements.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 2.08m. The launch sheet lists apartment starts of AED 2.08m/3.08m/4.4m for one/two/three bedrooms and AED 9.06m for townhouses. These are historical advertised terms, not live availability.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule totals 80% before completion and 20% at completion. Historical instalment dates are not instructions for a new purchase.
research.handoverNote: December 2028 is the launch estimate, also reported by Property Finder. Confirm the contractual date and current construction position.
